headword: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}

definitions.explanation: The rightmost lane (in Japan) of a multi-lane road or expressway, designated for overtaking slower vehicles. Drivers are expected to return to the travel lane after passing.

examples.japanese: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}って→移る：01232_utsuru⟧⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}す→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧。
examples.english: Move to the passing lane and overtake.

examples.japanese: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける→走り続ける：22070_hashiritsuzukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧だ。
examples.english: Continuously driving in the passing lane is a violation.

examples.japanese: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越し：09216_oikoshi⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}→走行車線：24736_soukoushasen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}りましょう→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: A slow car in the passing lane causes traffic jams, so return to the driving lane immediately after overtaking.

notes:
A compound of {追越|おいこし} (overtaking, passing) + ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (lane). In Japan's left-hand traffic system, the passing lane is on the right side. Staying in the {追越車線|おいこししゃせん} without passing ({通行帯違反|つうこうたいいはん}) is subject to a fine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the passing lane
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to exit the passing lane
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧: to block the passing lane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}→走行車線：24736_soukoushasen⟧: driving lane, travel lane — the standard lane for normal driving
- {登坂車線|とうはんしゃせん}: climbing lane — an extra lane on steep hills for slow vehicles
- ⟦{車線変更|しゃせんへんこう}→車線変更：17361_shasenhenkou⟧: lane change — the act of moving between lanes
